subject: Docs Quickstart - Request for technical demo (ByteScale)

From: Samir Rao <samir@bytescale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Docs Quickstart - Request for technical demo

Hi Marissa / Dylan,

I tried out the Docs Quickstart last week (great docs — super clear). We hit a couple of integration questions while wiring the SDK to our ingestion pipeline and I think a short technical demo would help us decide on next steps.

Quick background: ByteScale is building a document search product for enterprise customers (finance/legal). We have developer intent — want to validate performance of embeddings + retrieval across 50k docs and discuss best practices for caching and private deployment.

Would love a 30-minute technical session with an engineer — available windows next week (PST):
- Tue 3/3 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 3/4 11:00–12:00

Also attaching the quickstart logs and a short config snapshot that shows our tokenization settings (quickstart-logs.zip).

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Platform
ByteScale
samir@bytescale.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Samir — thanks for reaching out and for trying the quickstart. Really appreciate the context; this sounds exactly like the kind of developer-led evaluation we usually help with.

Dylan is our solutions engineer — I’m looping him in to cover the retrieval/embeddings side. We can do a 30-minute technical walkthrough and look at the logs you attached.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 3/3 10:00–10:30 (works for us)
- Tue 3/3 14:00–14:30
- Wed 3/4 11:00–11:30

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read with the sample queries we like to run.

I’m attaching a draft SOW / agenda that outlines topics we typically cover for a doc-retrieval proof of concept — feel free to flag anything you want added.

—Marissa

marissa_cole@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick intro + scope (5 min)
2) Walk through quickstart logs + ingestion config (10 min)
3) Retrieval/embedding tuning + caching recommendations (10 min)
4) Next steps & POC outline (5 min)
